text_blocks.snippet: Multisystem inflammatory syndrome (MIS) is a rare but serious condition associated with SARS-CoV-2, the virus that causes COVID-19. It is characterized by inflammation of various body parts, including the heart, lungs, kidneys, and brain. MIS can affect both children and adults. In children, it's often referred to as Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome in Children (MIS-C) and can resemble Kawasaki disease, according to Wikipedia.
